name: TrueWood Lite Dark Grey Oak Slats, Black Felt
summary: Solid rubberwood slats wrapped in real dark grey oak veneer on three sides, with a black acoustic felt backing.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet dimensions override photo estimates and rounded inch values: eight 27 mm slat faces with 10.5 mm rectangular felt gaps on a 37.5 mm pitch, 300 mm installed width, and 10 mm total depth (5 mm slat + 5 mm felt). Tile is eight pitches wide and 500 mm tall; charcoal dark grey oak veneer tones are sampled from the main listing photo, with black felt and procedural wrapping grain; the small edge easing is an appearance approximation.
